_about: Concrete, version-controlled watchlist of open-source repositories whose GitHub release feeds signal community milestones. This file exists so the Community cell's release sources are enumerated rather than described — there is no wildcard and no '<configured>' placeholder anywhere in the source table.
_selection_about: Chosen for relevance to non-developer-facing AI milestones AND for small feed size, so the bounded smoke stays inside max_response_bytes and adapter_budget_sec. Feed sizes observed at plan time: ollama 11 KB, mcp/servers 8 KB, langchain 72 KB. Deliberately excludes vllm (730 KB) and transformers (771 KB), which are legitimate sources but too heavy for a bounded smoke.

repositories.why: Local model runtime with a large non-specialist user base; releases are a genuine community milestone signal.
Reference MCP server collection; releases track ecosystem-wide protocol adoption.
One of the most widely referenced AI application frameworks; release cadence is a standing community signal.

_robots: github.com robots.txt permits /*/releases.atom for the configured user agent (verified at plan time). Requests are serialised via the github.com domain override (max_concurrency 1, min_interval 2s).
